text:
This newly opened dental clinic opened in October. It's a pink shop across from a 7-Eleven and near a traffic light. There are two resident dentists who specialize in orthodontics and dentures. They have a very gentle touch.
- We accept social security benefits, no upfront payment required.
- We offer a 900 baht dental scaling promotion with free fluoride treatment.
- We also offer a 5% discount on fillings.
- Parking is available in front of the shop and the restrooms are clean.
- We took my mother here for dentures, and she was very impressed.
